text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: (Master—this is our resolve.)

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: (I'll pour all my feelings into this run!)

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
W-What kind of burst is that...! Just how 
fast are you gonna get, Gran Alegria?!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Even in sprints—no, precisely because it's 
a sprint, that natural talent for speed 
will truly shine...!

Gran Alegria managed to finish ahead of my 
mentor's trainee!

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King Trainer
text_block_list.text:
—A complete defeat. Gran, compared to last 
spring, you've gotten unrecognizably 
stronger.

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Especially... the stability of her 
running. Without mental growth, she 
couldn't run like that.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I'm so glad you were able to feel 
it!
choice_data_list: —I want to tell you once more.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Our dream is to conquer all three 
divisions!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
It's just like before my debut. But my 
determination to take on the challenge 
might have shifted by twenty whole miles!
choice_data_list:
We've made up our minds to take on the 
challenge!

We've made up our minds to take on the 
challenge!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Even the dreams you couldn't fulfill... 
Trainer and I will inherit them!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: That's what we decided together!

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King Trainer
text_block_list.text:
"...I see. So that's the best choice for 
you all."

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Heh... You seem quite grounded, I must 
say. Your eyes are focused straight ahead 
on the path you must take.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Yes. I have no hesitation!
choice_data_list:
I was able to reach this point thanks to 
you.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Everything you've taught me has taken root 
inside my running.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
So! I'll prove it with my running, with my 
strength!
choice_data_list:
The future you've kept chasing — show me 
what form it takes!

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King Trainer
text_block_list.text:
...The road ahead is one you must walk 
alone.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Yes. This is the path we chose.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
The future that Gran Alegria is forging— 
Please look forward to infinity miles of 
it!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: ...To convey—my resolve.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Heheh, how on earth did I manage to 
forget that...? ―

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Thank you... Gran-chan.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
—"That was a magnificent run in the 
Takamatsunomiya Kinen! Is your next goal 
the Spring/Autumn Mile G1 double, as 
expected?"

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
You're right! Winning both the spring and 
autumn Mile G1s is definitely in my 
sights!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Still, that's not my only goal!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
I will conquer all three categories: 
Sprint, Mile, and Medium!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Y-You're taking on the Triple Crown across 
three divisions!?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I'll win the Sprinters Stakes for 
sprint, the Yasuda Kinen for mile, and the 
Tenno Sho (Autumn) for medium distance!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
This is what my three-division conquest 
looks like!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"The Sprinters Stakes is the traditional 
sprint GⅠ, so it's a no-brainer, right?"

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Because I heard the Tenno Sho (Autumn) is 
the middle-distance race Master wanted to 
win for the three-division sweep!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: Then, how about the Yasuda Kinen?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Because rumors say Ai-senpai is entering 
the race!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"Because unless you claim the title of the 
strongest in three divisions, you can't 
really call it conquering three divisions, 
can you?!"

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"Strength means speed—which means the mile 
is the strongest! I'll prove it by 
conquering all three divisions!"

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"‘A Challenge for a Historic Feat’... 
Online news, sports tabloids, everyone's 
buzzing about Gran-chan..."

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Conquering three distance categories— So 
you really are going to challenge it, 
Gran.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Yes... Gran-chan will also be competing 
against older generations in G1 races...

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: ...... Will everything... be all right...?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Gran-chan will be just fine!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"I mean, she even chose the Yasuda Kinen 
just to challenge Ai-san."

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
B-But... when it comes to an actual race, 
what if they end up like, like us...

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
...Are you saying you might cower before 
such a towering wall?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
...Yes. Being able to put up a good fight, 
yet never being allowed to win... that 
frustration...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
When facing the older generation... the 
word 'defeat' flashes across my mind...

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: You two should go watch the Yasuda Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"Because I'm sure it'll give me the 
courage to face Ai-san and the others!"

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"...I-Is Love-chan... really all right 
now...?"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: —I am going to Hong Kong.

text_block_list.name: Chrono & Bouquet
text_block_list.text: Hong Kong?! Hong Kong, you say?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Because Gran-chan's running reminded 
me.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
No matter how many times I lose, no matter 
how pathetic I look, there are people out 
there who shower me with love.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"That is why I run. Because I want to 
deliver love to everyone."

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Victory is the ultimate love, yes— but I 
always pour love into my running.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Everyone understands that too. —That's why 
I run.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to deliver love all across the 
world through my racing.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Just as declared, next is the ultimate 
showdown against Ai-senpai!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"I'm going to beat you at the Yasuda 
Kinen, Eye-senpai!"
